sections.content:
1. What grades does Delhi Public School, Jankipuram offer?

Ans: Delhi Public School, Jankipuram, Lucknow offers a whole education journey from Playgroup to grade 12th.

2. How do I enroll my child at Delhi Public School, Jankipuram?

Ans: To enroll your child, please visit the Admission page or Contact us page for detailed information and guidelines. You can also apply online through our registration form.

3. What are the school timings?

Ans: Delhi Public School, Jankipuram timings start from 7:45 A.M. to 2:00 P.M., Monday through Saturday.

4. Which board is the school affiliated with?

Ans: Our school is affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), New Delhi, under the affiliation number 2131718.

5. What is the student-teacher ratio at DPS Jankipuram?

Ans: 30:1 is the pupil-teacher ratio (PTR) mandated by the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE). The meaning of this is that for every 30 students, there should be one teacher. As per the CBSE ratio, our teacher-section ratio is 20:1 and student-teacher ratio is ……

6. What extracurricular activities are available?

Ans: We offer a wide range of extracurricular activities in our school, including sports academy, animation, coding academy and more.

7. Does the school have boarding (residential) facilities?

Ans: No, we do not provide residential facilities. Delhi Public School, Jankipuram, is a day school that gets over by 2:00 pm.

8. Does the DPS Jankipuram offer lunch or cafeteria services?

Ans: Yes, we provide our children with wholesome and delicious meals in our on-site cafeteria.

9. How often will there be PTM’s?

Ans: Based on School Content.

10. Are computer classes available at DPS Jankipuram?

Ans. Yes, computer classes are available at our school. We offer a comprehensive computer education program that includes coding like Coding Dojo. Also, these are supported by textbooks like……

11. Does Delhi Public School, Jankipuram provide medical facilities on campus?

Ans: Yes, DPS Jankipuram offers on-campus medical facilities. The school has a well-equipped medical room staffed by qualified professionals to provide first aid and attend to basic health needs of students during school hours.

12. Why Delhi Public School is so famous?

Ans: Delhi Public School (DPS) is renowned across India for its academic excellence, disciplined environment, and holistic approach to education. At DPS Jankipuram, this legacy continues with a strong emphasis on quality teaching, co-curricular enrichment, modern learning technologies, and value-based education. The school's commitment to nurturing well-rounded, future-ready individuals makes it a trusted and respected name among parents and students alike.

13. Why choose Delhi Public School, Jankipuram, for my child’s education?

Ans: DPS Jankipuram stands out by offering a balanced education that nurtures both academic excellence and holistic development. What truly sets us apart is our strong focus on beyond-the-curriculum learning, where students gain future-ready skills through programs in coding, animation, oluxi smart skills, and more.

14. How does Delhi Public School, Jankipuram, ensure student safety and security?

Ans: Student safety is our top priority. Delhi Public School, Jankipuram, has 24/7 security and CCTV facilities available.

15. Who is the founder of Delhi Public School Society?

Ans: Delhi Public School Society (DPSS), under the visionary leadership of Shri B.K. Chaturvedi (Chairman) and Shri V.K. Shunglu (Vice Chairman), is committed to delivering holistic and quality education to all members of society. This mission is deeply rooted in its guiding motto: "Service Before Self."

16. Who is the principal of DPS Jankipuram, Lucknow?

Ans: The principal of Delhi Public School, Jankipuram, is Ms. Neeru Bhaskar. With extensive experience in educational leadership, she leads the school’s academic and administrative initiatives.

ADMISSION

17. What is the fee structure of the school?

Ans: The fee structure at DPS Jankipuram is thoughtfully designed to reflect the comprehensive educational experience we offer.

18. Is there an admission fee or application fee?

Ans: Yes, there is a Rs.30000/- for PG to 10th and Rs.35000/- for class 11 and 12th non-refundable application fee required at the time of submission. Visit our Admissions page for more details.

19. What is the age criteria for admission?

Ans: Please visit our Admission Process page for details.

20. Can I transfer my child mid-year?

Ans: It depends on a case-by-case basis, based on seat availability and academic compatibility.

21. What documents are required for admission?

Ans: The required documents may vary depending on the class for which admission is sought. For detailed information, please visit our Admission Procedure page.

22. Is there an entrance exam for admission?

Ans: Yes, the school conducts an entrance exam for admission to Class Nursery to Class XI. Admission to Pre Nursery will be through informal interaction with the parents and the child.

TRANSPORTATION

23. Does DPS Jankipuram offer transportation services?

Ans: Yes, the school provides transportation services for students across Lucknow. To know the exact pick-up points, click here.

24. Which areas are covered by the school bus service?

Ans: Our buses cover all the nearby areas. You can check our Bus Route page for more details.

25. What are the school bus timings?

Ans: School bus timings may vary based on location. Once your child is enrolled, you will receive a detailed transportation schedule with specific pick-up and drop-off timings tailored to your route.

26. Are the school buses safe and well-maintained?

Ans: Yes. Our buses are equipped with all the safety measures, including GPS, CCTV, and first-aid kits (or given by the school) and undergo regular safety inspections and maintenance checks.

27. Do the school buses have trained staff?

Ans: Yes, each bus is accompanied by a trained driver and a female bus attendant to ensure student safety and supervision. (Change based on school)

28. Who do I contact for transportation-related queries or issues?

Ans: For any transportation-related queries or issues, you can reach out to our Transport Coordinator at [Phone Number] or email [Email Address].
